lines.text: Many learners say: Almost Japanese people like rice.
Better: Most Japanese people like rice.
Most! Most Japanese people like rice.

native.tip: 「ほとんどの人」は most people。almost は使えません。
native.caption: “Almost Japanese people like rice.”と言っていませんか？😅 「ほとんど」を almost と覚えているので、つい混ざります。“Most Japanese people like rice.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“Most”。“Most Japanese people like rice.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Say most people, not almost people.
en.caption: Do you say this? “Almost Japanese people like rice.” 😅 Most means the biggest part of a group. The natural way is “Most Japanese people like rice.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
